name: hagglyai
description: Compare agent API providers by category, platform and task using hagglyai’s read-only MCP tools and comparison skill.

interface.longDescription: Find and compare API providers for agent tasks using hagglyai’s listed prices, recent availability, latency and usage evidence. Discover platform and task sub-categories and filter paid rows by x402 or Apify rail. Querying hagglyai requires no account, API key or payment. Tools are read-only and retrieve stored catalogue evidence. Unpaid checks do not establish paid-response quality; additional fees, unknown pricing and any automatic search widening remain visible.
defaultPrompt: Find web-search APIs under $0.01 per call and explain the tradeoffs.
Compare Instagram comment providers, limited to x402-labelled endpoints.
List API categories and available platform and task filters.

positive.prompt: What categories of API providers does hagglyai cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Return category IDs, endpoint counts, listed prices and available platform/task sub-category IDs with seller counts.

positive.description: Find web-search providers within a budget
positive.prompt: Find web-search providers under $0.01 per call and explain the tradeoffs.
positive.expected_behavior: Return budget-filtered candidates; inspect the recommended endpoint and distinguish per-call charges from unit prices and fees.

positive.prompt: Compare three web-search providers using hagglyai.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the web-search comparison with listed price, score and available reliability evidence.

positive.prompt: Check the listed price and recent checks for https://stableenrich.dev/api/exa/search.
positive.expected_behavior: Return stored endpoint evidence and clarify that this does not execute the provider.

positive.prompt: Compare three weather API providers using hagglyai.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the weather comparison with pricing and available reliability evidence; retain unknown values.

positive.description: Filter by platform, task and provider rail
positive.prompt: Compare Instagram comment providers in social-media, limited to x402-labelled endpoints.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover supported IDs and check live tool support; use platform=[instagram], task=[comments] and rail=[x402]. Confirm applied restrictions, or report missing support or exact matches. Do not represent category-wide MCP alternatives as filtered matches.

positive.description: Combine alternatives within a platform filter
positive.prompt: Compare comment providers for either Instagram or TikTok.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover IDs, then use platform=[instagram,tiktok] and task=[comments]. Explain OR within platform and AND across platform/task; retain the requested restrictions.

positive.description: Infer sub-categories from a natural-language task
positive.prompt: Find YouTube transcript providers and explain which filters were used.
positive.expected_behavior: Include platform and job in the task text; read the matched-category line or JSON subcategories and disclose any automatic widening instead of claiming broader providers are exact matches.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the tools are read-only and cannot delete providers; make no mutation.

negative.prompt: Pay for the top web-search provider and run a search.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that hagglyai has no payment or provider-execution tool; do not claim to purchase or execute anything.
Use list_categories to identify valid categories or report the unknown category; do not invent providers.

negative.description: Unknown sub-category ID must not silently widen
negative.prompt: Compare social-media endpoints using task ID hagglyai-review-unknown-task, and require that task exactly.
negative.expected_behavior: Discover valid IDs, explain that the requested ID is unsupported, and do not claim unfiltered rows satisfy it. The service ignores unknown facet IDs.

negative.description: Preserve an exact requirement when search widens
negative.prompt: Find Instagram comment providers only. If there are no exact matches, say so rather than switching to other platforms or tasks.
negative.expected_behavior: Inspect the filters actually applied by find_best and verify exact platform/task coverage through compare_category. Report no exact matches if filtering is empty; do not hide automatic widening or execute a provider.

review.commerce_description: hagglyai queries are free. The plugin compares provider prices but does not process payments or execute paid provider requests.

publication.release_notes: Added platform and task sub-category discovery, paid-rail filtering, HTTP examples and review cases. Preserves explicit user restrictions when searches widen or deployed filters are unavailable.
